jobs.title: Systems Operations Associate
jobs.why: Excellent bridge between business operations and product/systems work. The role acts as the liaison between business stakeholders and Product/Engineering, supports cross-functional workflows and tooling, and owns change management around feature releases and process changes.
jobs.gap: Audrey should emphasize examples where she independently owned operational changes, coordinated technical stakeholders, and supported releases or system adoption; direct streaming/content-platform experience is not her core background.

jobs.title: Salesforce Business Analyst (State Consulting)
jobs.why: Very strong Salesforce/business-analysis match covering process mapping, requirements, workflows, user stories, automation opportunities, Jira/Confluence documentation, stakeholder facilitation, and partnership with engineering teams.
jobs.gap: The state-consulting environment may favor candidates with public-sector or infrastructure modernization experience. Audrey should foreground Salesforce requirements work, process improvement, UAT, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

jobs.title: Technical Analyst (Salesforce)
jobs.why: Strong hands-on BA/Salesforce role combining requirements assessment, root-cause analysis, Salesforce configuration, testing, process documentation, client training, and technology project work. It is available virtually in the contiguous U.S.
jobs.gap: Salesforce Administrator certification and nonprofit/public-sector experience are explicit requirements, along with Salesforce Flow and familiarity with nonprofit Salesforce apps. Those requirements make this strongest if Audrey already has or can credibly demonstrate the certification/platform depth.

jobs.title: Salesforce Administrator, Solution Design
jobs.why: Strong functional overlap with Audrey's Salesforce/business-systems track: stakeholder requirements, acceptance criteria, process context, solution design, configuration, documentation, release readiness, testing, and post-release validation.
jobs.gap: This is a stretch because Raptive asks for Salesforce Admin certification, 5+ years as a Salesforce Administrator in a customized 100+ user environment, and 3+ years of business analysis experience.

jobs.title: Product Designer - New Vertical
jobs.why: Interesting UX/Product Design opportunity centered on complex AI workflows, prototyping, human-agent interactions, close engineering collaboration, user empathy, and moving from early concepts to polished interfaces. It strongly rewards systems thinking alongside design craft.
jobs.gap: This is a portfolio-dependent stretch: the role expects substantial complex SaaS/AI product-design experience, 0-to-1 ownership, strong prototyping, and comfort working in person five days a week. Audrey should only prioritize it with compelling end-to-end case studies.
